data.name: Girivar
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Giri', meaning mountain, and 'Var', meaning protector. This name is given to those who are believed to protect and preserve the mountains and nature. In Hindu mythology, it is also the name of a sage who is known for his wisdom and knowledge.
